messages:
Sam: Quick sync: customers asked for project-scoped API keys with per-API entitlements (chat, embeddings, rerank) and short-lived ephemeral tokens for workers. Need roadmap and launch criteria.

Maria: +1. Scoped keys reduce blast radius. Security wants scope enforcement in control plane and KMS rotation hooks.

Alex: Router can enforce scopes at request ingress. Migration is the tough part: existing keys are org-wide. Options: opt-in new scoped keys, issue wrapper tokens, or phased enforcement with telemetry.

Jin: Tool-calling must honor token scopes or we risk cross-project tool access. Suggest mapping tools to required scopes in registry.

Lina: Enterprise asks: rotation webhook, audit trail per token, and single-click rotate in Console.

Maria: Also need HSM/KMS integration and a threat model. Ephemeral tokens should be validated by signed JWTs using short-lived JWKs and cacheable validation.

Alex: Draft API sketch:
```
POST /v1/tokens/ephemeral
{
  "project": "proj_ABC",
  "scopes": ["chat.generate","embeddings.create"],
  "ttl": 3600
}
Response: { "token": "ey...", "expires_at": 169... }
```
Runtime checks signature + scopes; router rejects out-of-scope ops.

Sam: Proposed GA criteria:
- Endpoints: create/revoke/rotate + ephemeral issuance
- Runtime: enforcement, per-token tracing ids
- Console: create scoped keys, show audit log, single-click rotate
- Backcompat: mark legacy keys and notify admins; 90-day migration window
- Perf: p99 latency delta <5% on chat path

Jin: For perf, add token validation cache at router and precompute scope bitmasks for fast checks.

Maria: Compliance sign-off (SOC2, GDPR) required before GA. Security to produce checklist.

Lina: Sales needs migration docs, SDK snippets, and email template for customers.

Alex: Tentative roadmap: Q1 prototype (ephemeral tokens + router checks), Q2 Console + audit + webhooks, Q3 rollout + SDK updates + sunsetting legacy keys.

Sam: Can eng produce a short RFC with endpoints, data model, and migration flows by Friday? I'll collate customer asks and launch criteria.

Alex: I'll author RFC. Data model: token_id, project_id, scopes, parent_key, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_history.

Maria: Security will add KMS/HSM notes and key lifecycle policy.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for ephemeral-token-service tomorrow 09:00 UTC :rocket:

Sam: Thanks — next steps: RFC -> design review -> plan. :thumbsup:
